#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <utility>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

#define sz(a) ((int)(a).size())
#define null NULL
#define mp make_pair
#define fi first
#define se second
#define pb push_back
#define all(a) (a).begin(), (a).end()
#define relaxMin(a, b) (a) = min((a), (b))
#define relaxMax(a, b) (a) = max((a), (b))
#define PI 3.1415926535897932384
typedef long long ll;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;

#define BITS(a) __builtin_popcount(a)
const double EPS = 1E-9;

typedef long double dbl;

typedef pair<dbl, dbl> Val; // a * fi + se

Val Add(const Val& f, const Val& s){
  return mp(f.fi + s.fi,
            f.se + s.se);
}

Val Sub(const Val& f, const Val& s){
  return mp(f.fi - s.fi,
            f.se - s.se);
}

Val Mult(const Val& f, dbl w){
  return mp(f.fi * w,
            f.se * w);
}

Val Div(const Val& f, dbl w){
  return mp(f.fi / w,
            f.se / w);
}

Val dp[1 << 20];
int n, k;
double p[25];

double Solve(int vr){
  if(p[vr] < EPS) return 0.0;

  dp[0] = Val(1.0, 0.0);
  for(int msk = 1;msk < (1 << n);++msk){
    if(msk & (1 << vr)) continue;
    Val ri(0.0, 0.0);
    dbl same = 0.0;

    for(int i = 0;i < n;++i)
      if(i != vr)
        if(msk & (1 << i)){
          same += p[i];
          ri = Add(ri, Mult(dp[msk ^ (1 << i)], p[i]));
        }

    dp[msk] = Div(ri, 1.0 - same);
  }

  Val tot(1.0, 0.0);
  for(int msk = 1;msk < (1 << n);++msk)
    if(!(msk & (1 << vr))){
      tot = Add(tot, dp[msk]);
    }

  dbl alp = (1.0 - tot.se) / tot.fi;

  Val bad(0.0, 0.0);
  for(int msk = 0;msk < (1 << n);++msk){
    if(msk & (1 << vr)) continue;
    if(BITS(msk) >= k) bad = Add(bad, dp[msk]);
  }

  return 1.0 - (alp * bad.fi + bad.se);
}

int main(){
  int n, k;
  cin >> n >> k;
  for(int i = 0;i < n;++i)
    cin >> p[i];

  for(int i = 0;i < n;++i)
    cout << fixed << setprecision(12) << Solve(i) << (i + 1 == n ? '\n' : ' ');

  return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
